environment.purpose: Calibration for national games: the real averages of 2004 Olympic Games men's basketball tournament (Athens, Greece), the last senior FIBA tournament completed before the edition (the repository's environment policy).
environment.team_turnover_note: FIBA's records keep no separate team turnovers; every turnover is a player's.
